title: Subject-Related Codes in Field 008 - Continuing Resources (Serials)
summary: LC guidelines for coding subject-related 008 elements in MARC 21 continuing resource (serial) records: 008/24 nature of entire work (EntW, one code), 008/25-27 nature of contents (Cont, up to three codes in alphabetical order), biography as the single code h, and 008/29 conference publication (Conf = 1 when --Congresses is a form subdivision). Not relevant to heading-string validation.
validation_rules: [LC practice] 008/24 (EntW): enter one code only, when the work consists entirely of a type of material with a designated code. (Appendix G sec. 1)
[LC practice] 008/25-27 (Cont): up to three codes, in alphabetical order, for types of material forming a significant part of the work. (Appendix G sec. 2)
[LC practice] Biography in serials is coded only as `h` (autobiography, individual, or collective), in 008/24 if entirely biographical, otherwise in 008/25-27. (Appendix G sec. 3)
[LC practice] 008/29 (Conf): `1` if `--Congresses` is used as a form subdivision in any 6XX field; otherwise `0`. (Appendix G sec. 4)

sections.heading: 1. 008/24 (Nature of entire work)
sections.text: Note: This data element is labeled EntW in OCLC Connexion.

sections.heading: a. General principle
sections.text: To any work that consists entirely of a type of material for which a corresponding code has been designated, enter that code in EntW. Only one code may be used in EntW.

sections.heading: b. Codes and definitions
sections.text: A full list of the available codes, together with definitions and application guidelines, is available by clicking on EntW in OCLC Connexion.

sections.heading: 2. 008/25-27 (Nature of contents)
sections.text: Note: This data element is labeled Cont in OCLC Connexion.

sections.heading: a. General principle
sections.text: To any work that contains a significant amount of a type of material for which a corresponding code is available, enter that code in Cont. As many as three codes may be use in Cont, in alphabetical order.

sections.heading: b. Codes and definitions
sections.text: A full list of the available codes, together with definitions and application guidelines, is available by clicking on Cont in OCLC Connexion.

sections.heading: 3. Coding for biography
sections.text:
Unlike the books format, which uses field 008/34 and provides several codes for different types of biographical material, the continuing resources format uses fields 008/24 or 008/25-27 and provides only the single code h to designate any type of biographical material. Use h for autobiography, individual biography, or collective biography. Use the code in field 008/24 if the item consists entirely of biographical material, or in field 008/25-27 if the item contains biographical material as well as other types of material.

Note: For guidelines on what type of material is considered biographical and what type is not, see Appendix F, sec. 5.b and 5.c.

sections.heading: 4. 008/29 (Conference publication)
sections.text:
Note: This data element is labeled Conf in OCLC Connexion.

If --Congresses is used as a form subdivision in the 6XX fields, enter the code 1 in Conf. Otherwise, use the code 0.
